tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send an email to one or more email addresses, with a subject and body. Do not use this for posting in a team chat channel, notifying the user's own phone or texting a phone number.

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a team chat channel such as #general. Cannot send email. Do not use this for emailing someone, notifying the user's own phone or texting a phone number.

tools.name: push_message
tools.description: Send a push notification to the current user's own phone. Cannot reach anyone else. Do not use this for emailing someone, posting in a team chat channel or texting a phone number.

tools.name: dispatch_message
tools.description: Send an SMS text message to a phone number. Do not use this for emailing someone, posting in a team chat channel or notifying the user's own phone.
